name: Platinum + Etoposide + Durvalumab (CASPIAN) for extensive-stage SCLC
histology: small cell lung cancer (small cell carcinoma; high-grade neuroendocrine)

biomarkers.note: Not biomarker-gated. Durvalumab (anti-PD-L1) is added to a platinum plus etoposide backbone regardless of PD-L1 status in extensive-stage SCLC. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Small Cell Lung Cancer v1.2027, SCL-E.

lineOfTherapy: first-line (primary) systemic therapy for extensive-stage SCLC

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: extensive-stage small cell lung cancer, treatment-naive
eligibilityCriteria.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Small Cell Lung Cancer
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v1.2027, Primary Therapy for Extensive-Stage SCLC (SCL-E 1 of 6); lines 970 to 973

drugs.name: CARBOplatin

provenance.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Small Cell Lung Cancer
provenance.locator: SCL-E 1 of 6, line 970 (Carboplatin AUC 5 to 6 Day 1 and Etoposide 80 to 100 mg/m2 Days 1, 2, 3 and Durvalumab 1500 mg Day 1 every 21 days x 4 cycles)

drugs.notes: PREFERRED PLATINUM (choose CARBOplatin OR CISplatin, not both). Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) SCLC v1.2027, SCL-E line 970. CARBOplatin Calvert AUC target 5 to 6, day 1 (dosePerUnit = 5; source range AUC 5 to 6). Cisplatin alternative: 75 to 80 mg/m2 day 1 (line 972).

drugs.name: Etoposide

provenance.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Small Cell Lung Cancer
provenance.locator: SCL-E 1 of 6, lines 970 and 972 (Etoposide 80 to 100 mg/m2 Days 1, 2, 3)

drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) SCLC v1.2027, SCL-E lines 970 and 972. Etoposide 80 to 100 mg/m2 IV days 1, 2, 3 (dosePerUnit = 100, top of the source range 80 to 100).

drugs.name: Durvalumab

provenance.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Small Cell Lung Cancer
provenance.locator: SCL-E 1 of 6, lines 970 to 971 (Durvalumab 1500 mg Day 1 every 21 days x 4 cycles followed by maintenance Durvalumab 1500 mg Day 1 every 28 days)

drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) SCLC v1.2027, SCL-E lines 970 to 971 (CASPIAN). Durvalumab 1500 mg IV day 1 every 21 days during the 4 induction cycles, THEN maintenance durvalumab 1500 mg IV day 1 every 28 days after chemotherapy stops (category 1 for all).

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: platinum plus etoposide antiemetic prophylaxis per guideline tier (cisplatin variant is highly emetogenic).

supportiveCare: Four induction cycles of platinum/etoposide/durvalumab every 21 days, THEN maintenance durvalumab 1500 mg every 28 days until progression or unacceptable toxicity (note the maintenance interval changes from every 21 to every 28 days). Source: SCLC v1.2027, SCL-E lines 970 to 973.
Cisplatin variant (choose one platinum): cisplatin 75 to 80 mg/m2 day 1 with IV hydration and nephro-/oto-/neurotoxicity monitoring; etoposide 80 to 100 mg/m2 days 1 to 3 (line 972).
Monitor for immune-related adverse events (durvalumab): thyroid, hepatic, pneumonitis, colitis, endocrinopathies.

monitoring: renal function before each platinum cycle
immune-related adverse event surveillance (thyroid, liver, pneumonitis, colitis) for durvalumab

doseModificationRules.text: Hold durvalumab and manage per immunotherapy toxicity guidance (corticosteroids for grade 2 or higher); permanently discontinue for severe/recurrent irAEs. Chemotherapy dose modifications per marrow/renal status.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: line 73273 (platinum plus etoposide as the SCLC induction backbone)

guideline.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Small Cell Lung Cancer
guideline.locator: Primary Therapy for Extensive-Stage SCLC (SCL-E 1 of 6), Preferred: Carboplatin AUC 5 to 6 (or Cisplatin 75 to 80 mg/m2) day 1 + Etoposide 80 to 100 mg/m2 days 1 to 3 + Durvalumab 1500 mg day 1 every 21 days x 4 cycles followed by maintenance Durvalumab 1500 mg day 1 every 28 days (CASPIAN), lines 970 to 973

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for extensive-stage SCLC (#12), CASPIAN chemoimmunotherapy. CARBOplatin AUC 5 to 6 day 1 (choose carboplatin OR cisplatin 75 to 80 mg/m2), Etoposide 80 to 100 mg/m2 days 1 to 3, and Durvalumab 1500 mg day 1 every 21 days for 4 induction cycles followed by maintenance durvalumab 1500 mg every 28 days are dose-grounded to Standard Guidelines (NCCN) SCLC v1.2027, SCL-E (lines 970 to 973). ISMP tall-man applied (CARBOplatin, CISplatin). Not biomarker-gated; extensive-stage, first-line, palliative intent. No field is set to VERIFY. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
